digest.component_or_area: store initialization and project mapping migration
propositions: Existing stores without .bridge_state/projects.json must be migrated to seed a projects mapping with legacy_default without writing ticket events
The migration must be implemented as two idempotent ensure units in the registry that run at init, re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot
The seed unit writes .bridge_state/projects.json only when absent and when the store has existing tickets, setting legacy_default and projects from Backend.project, making zero commits when converged
The capability-stamp backstop unit adds multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities only when the mapping holds more than one project and the token is absent
The two new ensure unit ids must be registered in REGISTRY_IDS and _registry() in ensures.py, and added to the expected id-set literal in test_registry_id_set_is_frozen
A second sweep of both units must return ok and leave the tickets-branch tip SHA unchanged, and multi-project stamped stores must still pass check_store_compat on this binary
